reviews.comment: Everyone's favorite SeaDaddy;), you literally have to try harder to fail than to pass. It's college, you should want to study since you're paying for it and its your future

Not too bad of a dude, just teaching a horribly designed class. The class is a weed-out class, but it could be better. Make sure you study 1000000 PowerPoint slides verbatim to pass the class. One of the three instructors who teaches the class. Would like to see Captain Tim in a class he's passionate about.

Not only is Captain Timothy Barrows extremely knowledgeable about the course subject, he's one of the few professors that wants students to truly apply themselves and understand the material, not just pass an exam. At first it was a bit overwhelming but he guided our confidence with multiple choice questions that transitioned into open ended

Although Mate tim is a funny professor, he grades strictly and his tests are mostly free response and a majority of the course grade. Study well in advance and if you start failing take action immediately, he lets you review your test so you can see what you missed. Completely doable if you put in the effort.

I studied for hours for every test, but still struggled. The professor required the date in a specific format (day, month spelled out, year) and took off 15–20 points each time it was incorrect. He only mentioned it once before the first test and never reminded us again. This significantly impacted my grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Capt. Tim teaches pretty decently, but his tests are fair. It's not supposed to be easy, this is college and you're going into an industry where mistakes cost lives. If you wanted easy, you should have enrolled into an online community college. Work ethic, determination, and commitment to your degree will help you pass, not whining

Mate Tim runs a tough course requiring time and self-learning, but if you put in the effort, you'll succeed. He grades strictly to reflect real shipboard standards, where there's no room for error. He prepares you well for the industry and future classes. He ensures you're knowledgeable and competent, by the end. Great instructor overall!

Course is taught with two different professors who both contradict each other. Exams are very difficult and all short response answer. If the class starts doing good, he will make the test harder. Seems to bring him joy, seeing people fail. No care for the cadet. He could care less if you are failing.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Everything must be followed to tee. Zero Room for error. Extremely strict for what is supposed to be a freshman class.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy
